## Measured: S1, N3 and N5 · 2026-11-27T14:24Z

PR: #37990 (draft, docs only, head `5c0e0ef6`). Tree `origin/main` 57ab0876. Probe: a real `ObjectQL` over a real `SqlDriver` / `MongoDBDriver`, one metadata-bound `beforeInsert` hook (`bindHooksToEngine`) on `zz_case` whose `ctx.api` insert into `zz_note` hits a unique constraint on a pre-seeded value. Servers: PostgreSQL 16.15, MongoDB 8.0.38 standalone, MongoDB 8.0.38 single-node replica set; SQLite as the contrast.

| Path | SQLite | PostgreSQL (S1) | MongoDB replica set (N5) | MongoDB standalone (N3) |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| control: hook writes a valid row | stored | stored | stored | **refused**, nothing stored |
| hook body catches the failure | stored, side write absent | **refused** `25P02` | **refused** `251` | refused |
| `onError: 'log'` | stored | **refused** `25P02` | **refused** `251` | refused |
| `retryPolicy {maxRetries: 2}`, 2nd attempt valid | stored, retry row kept | **refused**; both retries answered `25P02` | **refused**; both retries answered `251` | refused |
| `retryPolicy` + `onError: 'log'` | stored | **refused** `25P02` | **refused** `251` | refused |

- S1 as expected: refused with `25P02` on all three paths, nothing stored (no row, no side write). The outer error is the raw driver error (`code: '25P02'`, no `status`); the hook itself saw `DUPLICATE_RECORD` 409 (SQLSTATE `23505`).
- N5: a replica set behaves like PostgreSQL: MongoDB code `251` "Transaction with { txnNumber: 2 } has been aborted.", nothing stored.
- N3: on a standalone server every write on an object with such a hook is refused, even when nothing fails: "This MongoDB deployment does not support retryable writes. Please add retryWrites=false to your connection string." Re-run with `retryWrites=false`: the same message on all five paths. A write to an object with no such hook succeeds on the same server.

`hooks.mdx` and the released `a8e09bb` entry in `packages/objectql/CHANGELOG.md` now say this (#37990). Still saying "read in code, not measured": `skills/objectstack-data/references/data-hooks.md:60` and eval `hooks-security-seeds-datasources.json:317` (Tier H, left for its own card).

## Addendum to the measurement above · 2026-11-27T14:27Z

The N3 line "A write to an object with no such hook succeeds on the same server", which `hooks.mdx` in #37990 states as "Writes to an object that opens no unit are unaffected", is measured through the engine, not only with `mongosh`. Each probe run seeds `zz_note` with `engine.insert('zz_note', { code: 'dup' })` on the same `ObjectQL` over the same standalone `MongoDBDriver`. `zz_note` carries no hook, so that write opens no unit. The seed succeeded in all 10 standalone runs: 5 paths with the default connection string and 5 with `retryWrites=false`. Every one of those runs reads back `noteRows: ["dup"]`, while the hooked `zz_case` write in the same run was refused.
